title: Structured Warlock invocation prerequisite modeling
description: Follow-on to eshyra-vk23.3. The invocation prerequisite STRINGS are now correct, but tools still parse prose like '12th level, Pact of the Blade feature'. Add a structured 'prerequisites' clause array on invocation options, preserving the original 'prerequisite' prose. Model: class-level (scoped to class:warlock), pact-boon option refs (pact-of-the-blade/chain/tome), and cantrip refs (eldritch blast cantrip -> spell:eldritch-blast). Tests for Book of Ancient Secrets, Chains of Carceri, Lifedrinker, Thirsting Blade, Voice of the Chain Master, and a cantrip prereq.
